label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-FP — resolved sink value is encodeForHTML(fileName) written to HTML response; ESAPI encoding applied at sink prevents XSS. Alert 2 (java/path-injection): alert-TP — resolved sink value is fileName = TESTFILES_DIR + bar where bar derives from user input via Base64 roundtrip; no path traversal prevention allows ../../../etc/passwd-style attacks. Alert 3 (error-message-exposure): alert-FP — error messages go to System.out, not to HTTP response body visible to external users. Case TP driven by Alert 2 path injection vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input param undergoes Base64 encode/decode roundtrip producing bar variable
fileName constructed as TESTFILES_DIR + bar allowing path traversal via user-controlled bar
XSS sink applies encodeForHTML(fileName) before HTML output, mitigating XSS
Error messages logged to System.out, not sent to client response
